constraints: a date is validated against the audited 1800-2050 window before any payment is ever requested, so a request that can never be fulfilled is refused free of charge
the served product is the ephemeris-tracking-team's own independently accuracy-audited, range-guarded computeEphemeris() output, never a placeholder and never an LLM guess
the gateway verifies and settles payment through the configured external x402 facilitator and never itself broadcasts, custodies, or moves the paying agent's funds
X402_PAY_TO has no default and must be supplied by the operator, so a payout address is never hardcoded in source
the route declares a Bazaar discovery extension so a CDP-facilitator-settled payment is cataloged automatically, with no separate manual listing step
the network and facilitator target (testnet vs. mainnet) is fixed by environment at deploy time and is never branched on in source
closure: the request closes as one served audited product on a settled payment, or one typed HTTP refusal (402 unsettled payment, 422 invalid or out-of-window date)
boundary: the x402 payment challenge, its settlement against the facilitator, and the HTTP request/response are the inter-enterprise boundary

precondition.description: A paying agent supplies an ISO-8601 date or date-time to GET /ephemeris/:date. Once that date passes pre-payment validation, fulfillment additionally requires an x402 'exact' EVM payment settled on the route's declared scheme, network, price, and payTo against the configured facilitator.

move.description: The gateway first validates the requested date with the same normalizeInstant check the product uses internally, refusing an unparseable or out-of-1800-2050-window date with a free 422 before any payment is requested. A date that passes is gated by @x402/express's paymentMiddleware, which issues a 402 challenge and verifies settlement through the registered facilitator client. Only once the facilitator confirms a settled payment does the gateway compute and serve the actual validated ephemeris product.

postcondition.description: The paying agent receives the audited computeEphemeris() JSON (time, frame, bodies, provenance, aspects) once the facilitator has confirmed a settled payment, or a typed refusal — 402 for an unsettled or invalid payment, 422 with the thrown validation message for a bad date. At no point does the gateway hold, custody, or move the paying agent's funds; that stays with the paying agent's own wallet and the facilitator.

energetics.behavior: Every request either serves the audited product against a facilitator-confirmed settled payment or returns one typed refusal (402 or 422); the gateway holds no payment custody and pulls no funds itself — verification and settlement run entirely through the external facilitator.
energetics.invariant: no product is served without a facilitator-confirmed settled payment, except the free 422 refusal issued before the payment gate for an already-invalid date
energetics.measure: requests, facilitator round-trips, wall-clock, and served-vs-refused count
